review_notes: I read the whole file. It defines one isomorphism (`unitriangularStageUnderlyingAffineSpaceIso`) and two preimage lemmas. All three are built on Mathlib's `AffineSpace`, `AffineSpace.SpecIso`, `Scheme.asOver`, `Spec.preimage` and `Over.isoMk`. The file defines no new notion of affine space, polynomial ring or iso structure. It only compares the project's own unitriangular stage with the Mathlib object. A grep for related uses showed sibling files (`UnitriangularGeometry`, `AdditiveProductAffineSpace`, `UnitriangularStageProjectionBridge`) that use the same Mathlib machinery. I did not read those siblings in detail, so I can't rule out a similar comparison there, but nothing in this file competes with Mathlib.
